app.name: Designer
app.title: Component Designer
app.description: Electra.Academy can simulate wide variety of digital electronics and logical components to provide an easy and comfortable way to create circuits, documents and course material online. One of the coolest feature in Electra.Academy is, that user can define a new or custom component.

dialog.test_info: Test page for your designed and coded draw2d shape

files.title: Shared Components
files.intro: All components from your groups and public workspaces. Open one to edit it. When you save, you get your own copy (in My Components) and the original stays untouched.

review.title: Review
review.intro: Components waiting for your approval. Your vote is worth the review points your workspace admin gave you. Once enough points add up, the component goes live. A single reject stops it.
review.deletion_notice: This document is up for deletion. Approving removes it for everyone here.
review.my_points_hint: Your vote adds this many points
review.withdraw_explain: Withdraw this request? It will be removed as if you never submitted it.
review.not_open: This review is no longer open
review.load_failed: Could not load the review document
review.no_change_comment: No note - the author didn't say what changed.
review.reject_explain: Rejecting closes this request right away. The author has to make changes and submit it again.
review.accept_explain: As an admin, you can approve this right now and skip the usual review. Continue?
review.instruction_reviewer: The author is asking for your approval. Once enough people accept it, it goes live for everyone in the workspace.
review.instruction_admin: As an admin of this workspace, you can accept it immediately.
review.instruction_voted: Thanks, you've already approved this. Once enough people do, it goes live.

activity.title: Activity
activity.intro: What's happening across your workspaces: how your drafts turned out, reviews waiting for you, and your own actions.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.intro: A workspace makes sure everyone sees exactly the components meant for them. You decide who belongs, and everything you share there stays with exactly those people. A workspace can contain more workspaces, from a small group up to a whole organization: the higher up you post a component, the more people you reach. Open one to explore, or create your own and invite others.
workspaces.create_needs_parent: Open a workspace first, then create a sub-workspace inside it.
workspaces.required_score_hint: How many approval points a document needs before it goes live here. 0 = no review.

draft.title: My Components
draft.intro: Your own components live here: your private ones, and your copy of any shared component you have changed. Only you can see them. Want to share your version? Promote it to make it your group's version, or Distribute it to other workspaces you are in. If a workspace uses review, your version is checked there before it goes live.
draft.review_points_explain: {{have}} of {{need}} approval points so far. Once it reaches {{need}}, your version goes live for the group.
draft.kind_personal_explain: This circuit lives only in your personal space. Nobody else can see it.
draft.kind_personal_copy_explain: This is your own copy of a shared circuit. Promote it to send your changes for review. Once approved, they become your group's version.
